body_markdown:
If you have been eyeing the new[Dream Sight™ Floor Stand](https://owletcare.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=FloorStand) , you probably have a few practical questions before adding it to cart. How does it attach? Does it tip over? Will it work as your baby moves from bassinet to crib to toddler bed? Below, we're answering the most common questions about setup, safety, and compatibility, so you know exactly what to expect before it arrives.


### **What camera is this compatible with?**


The new Floor Stand is designed exclusively for the[Dream Sight™](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-sight?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=dreamsight) camera. It is not compatible with other camera brands or monitor systems. The Dream Sight camera is sold separately from the Dream Sight Floor Stand accessory, unless purchased in a[bundle](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sight-camera-with-floor-stand/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamSight_FloorStand%20) .


### **Do I need tools to set it up?**


No tools are required. The Floor Stand is quick and easy to set up right out of the box, with simple threaded pieces that screw together by hand in minutes. The stand can be used freestanding or secured to the wall with the included U-clip wall anchor, which is recommended when positioning it within 3 feet of a crib.


### **Can I move it from room to room?**


Yes! The Floor Stand is designed to be portable and easy to reposition. Because it's freestanding, you can move it from room to room without any tools or wall attachment required. At 12 pounds with a compact footprint, it's easy to relocate as your baby's sleep spaces change, from a bedside bassinet to a nursery crib to a toddler bed.


### **Do I need to attach it to the wall?**


The Floor Stand is freestanding on its own. A U-clip wall anchor is included and recommended for added stability whenever the stand is positioned within 3 feet of a crib.


### **What are the two height settings for?**


One height setting is optimized for bassinet height, and the other is optimized for crib and toddler bed height. This allows the stand to adjust as your baby's sleep space changes, without requiring a new setup at each stage.


### **Can I adjust the camera angle?**


Yes! The Floor Stand features manual 360° pan-and-tilt control, allowing for precise positioning and a stable, top-down view of your baby's sleep space.


### **What safety certifications does it have?**


The included cable management guards are ASTM certified for safe cord management near your baby's sleep space. The included U-clip wall anchor also provides added stability when positioning the setup within 3 feet of a crib.


### **What's in the box?**


Each Dream Sight Floor Stand includes the floor stand with weighted base, ASTM certified cable management guards, a power cord, and a U-clip wall anchor. The Dream Sight camera is not included and sold separately, unless purchased in a[bundle](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sight-camera-with-floor-stand/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamSight_FloorStand%20) .


****


**The takeaway:** **** The Dream Sight Floor Stand is built to be simple to set up, stable when in use, and flexible enough to move with your baby from one sleep stage to the next. Whether you're avoiding wall mounting altogether or just want more freedom in where the camera sits, the Floor Stand adjusts to fit your space.
